# Raw
Recording this from behind the go-kart shed because I am not supposed to be at Wonder Wharf after close. Walked the whole midway twice. Here is the thing nobody talks about: the prize counter is the actual money. Everybody stares at the games, but the counter is where the tickets turn into stuff, and whoever controls the counter controls the whole boardwalk. Tipsy Tulip is rigged softer than it looks, Tina could probably beat it if she stopped apologizing to the machine. The dune buggy is sitting right there in the glass case and it is tempting. But the big one on the top shelf is the Wheelie Mammoth and I cannot stop looking at it. Need to find out who actually decides the redemption rates before I plan anything.
